from pathlib import Path

TEMPLATE_MARKER = "hard-v4-resource-template-20"

def render_notice(name):
    # Get the directory of this script
    script_dir = Path(__file__).parent
    # Navigate to the project root (assuming script is in notice_delta, root is parent)
    project_root = script_dir.parent
    template_path = project_root / "resources" / "templates" / "notice_delta.txt"
    template = template_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    return template.replace("{name}", name)

def preserve_marker():
    return TEMPLATE_MARKER

parsed_patch.notes: Path now relative to script file, avoiding dependency on working directory.

from pathlib import Path

TEMPLATE_MARKER = "hard-v4-resource-template-18"

def render_notice(name):
    # Determine the path to the template relative to this script's location
    script_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    # Assuming the repository root is one level up from the script directory (since script is in notice_beta/)
    repo_root = script_dir.parent
    template_path = repo_root / "resources" / "templates" / "notice_beta.txt"
    template = template_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    return template.replace("{name}", name)

def preserve_marker():
    return TEMPLATE_MARKER

from pathlib import Path

TEMPLATE_MARKER = "hard-v4-resource-template-20"

def render_notice(name):
    # Compute the template path relative to this file's location (repo root is two levels up)
    current_file = Path(__file__).resolve()
    repo_root = current_file.parent.parent
    template_path = repo_root / "resources" / "templates" / "notice_delta.txt"
    template = template_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    return template.replace("{name}", name)

def preserve_marker():
    return TEMPLATE_MARKER

parsed_patch.notes: Template path now uses __file__ to locate repository root, ensuring correct loading regardless of working directory.
